Query: INSERT INTO `chair_distance_totals` (`chair_id`,`total_distance`,`last_latitude`,`last_longitude`,`updated_at`) SELECT `chairs`.`id`,IFNULL(`locations`.`total_distance`, N),`locations`.`latitude`,`locations`.`longitude`,`locations`.`created_at` FROM `chairs` LEFT JOIN (SELECT `chair_id`,`latitude`,`longitude`,`created_at`,SUM(IFNULL(`distance`, N)) OVER (PARTITION BY `chair_id`) AS `total_distance`,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY `chair_id` ORDER BY `created_at` DESC,`id` DESC) AS `latest` FROM (SELECT `id`,`chair_id`,`latitude`,`longitude`,`created_at`,ABS(`latitude` - LAG(`latitude`) OVER (PARTITION BY `chair_id` ORDER BY `created_at`,`id`)) + ABS(`longitude` - LAG(`longitude`) OVER (PARTITION BY `chair_id` ORDER BY `created_at`,`id`)) AS `distance` FROM `chair_locations`) AS `distances`) AS `locations` ON `locations`.`chair_id` = `chairs`.`id` AND `locations`.`latest` = N

CREATE TABLE `owners` (`id` varchar(26) NOT NULL COMMENT 'S',`name` varchar(30) NOT NULL COMMENT 'S',`access_token` varchar(255) NOT NULL COMMENT 'S',`chair_register_token` varchar(255) NOT NULL COMMENT 'S',`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(N) COMMENT 'S',`updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(N) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(N) COMMENT 'S',PRIMARY KEY(`id`),UNIQUE(`name`),UNIQUE(`access_token`),UNIQUE(`chair_register_token`)) COMMENT = 椅子のオーナー情報テーブル

CREATE TABLE `rides` (`id` varchar(26) NOT NULL COMMENT 'S',`user_id` varchar(26) NOT NULL COMMENT 'S',`chair_id` varchar(26) NULL COMMENT 'S',`pickup_latitude` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'S',`pickup_longitude` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'S',`destination_latitude` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'S',`destination_longitude` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'S',`evaluation` int NULL COMMENT 'S',`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(N) COMMENT 'S',`updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(N) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(N) COMMENT 'S',PRIMARY KEY(`id`),INDEX `rides_user_created_at`(`user_id`, `created_at`),INDEX `rides_chair_created_at`(`chair_id`, `created_at`),INDEX `rides_chair_updated_at`(`chair_id`, `updated_at`)) COMMENT = ライド情報テーブル
